summary: The daily answers check costs each member one summary per day instead of one per restart and half-hour recheck. A member keeps its summary at a cut beside its database for the rest of the day, readable by its owner only, so a restart and every peer's ask at that cut are answered from it, unless a claim older than the cut has been admitted since (a peer replaying its backlog), which computes it again; it rechecks a differing peer every two hours instead of every thirty minutes; and it reads each kind ten thousand claims per statement, so no read holds the WAL for minutes. Claim counts now compare only between members that finished trimming the same checkpoint, since a summary kept all day would otherwise keep a count taken before that day's trim

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; only the check's own reads and cache change.

schema.detail: No schema change. The summary is kept in a file beside the database, claims.sqlite3.answers.json, which an older build ignores.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; the summary's digests are the same as before.

compatibility.detail: The wire format is unchanged. A kept summary is used only by the build that computed it, so an upgrade or a swap-back computes again.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade.

manual.detail: No manual step. Deleting the file only makes the next ask compute again.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the half-hour recheck and the in-memory twenty-minute cache; the file is then ignored.
